thread:
carol: Heads-up — started seeing a small spike in 4xx/5xx from api-gateway around 08:45 UTC. 403s and a few 502s. Any idea if this is traffic or a config flapping?

alice: saw same in dashboards. 403s concentrated on /v1/generate (internal token errors?), 502s look spread across regions.

ben: tagging observability folks — which dashboard is the canonical one for gateway error breakdown?

carol: Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/8b7gX/errors-overview?orgId=1 (filters: job=api-gateway). Also check the per-route heatmap on that board.

alice: logs are in Loki — quick query for 403s: `{job="api-gateway"} |= "status=403" | json | count_over_time({job=\"api-gateway\"}[5m])`

ben: nice. For 502s you can run `|= "upstream_status=502"` or look at nginx error logs: `/var/log/nginx/error.log` on the gateway pods (k8s).

carol: ops-bot, can you post the active alert for error-rate-high?

ops-bot: ALERT: error-rate-high (api-gateway) triggered at 2026-03-17T08:47:10Z — 5m error rate = 2.3% (threshold 2.0%).

alice: that % is above SLO of 1.0% but below our emergency threshold (5%). Might be a transient bump.

ben: any recent deploys to gateway in last 30m? deploy-bot, pls check.

deploy-bot: Recent deploys: gateway v3.14.2 at 2026-03-17T08:30Z by alice. No rollbacks.

carol: hmm deploy ~15m before spike. Can we confirm traffic pattern? maybe a client-side change causing auth failures.

alice: touching the token validation code earlier in the branch but merged yesterday. Not aware of a client change.

ben: proposal: temporarily silence non-urgent alert to avoid noise while we triage, but keep paging threshold intact. Who can approve quick alert bump?

carol: I can bump the warning threshold for 15m in PagerDuty -> routing rule, but prefer we update Prom rule if needed. Suggest: increase alert eval window to 10m to smooth flaps.

alice: created a small PR to extend alert eval window: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/342 — reviewers: ben, carol.

ben: reviewing now. If we change eval window we should also add a note in the runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/API+Gateway+Errors

carol: triage checklist: 1) confirm deploy changes (alice) 2) check client usage logs (billing/traffic) 3) inspect gateway pods for restarts (`kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=api-gateway -o wide`) 4) correlate region-specific 502s to node outages in cloud console.

alice: running `kubectl logs -n infra $(kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=api-gateway -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') | grep "status=403" | tail -n 50` now.

carol: also add a quick Loki query for request latency > 5s: `{job=\"api-gateway\"} | json | duration > 5s` — looking for timeouts that might produce 502s.

ben: FYI if anyone wants to see the per-tenant breakdown use this grafana link with template select: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/8b7gX/errors-overview?var-tenant=all

alice: found ~12 requests with missing auth header around spike window — looks like a client-side regression from a partner. Opening contact ticket.

carol: great. recommend: leave alert as-is for now but add a short-term suppression for the warning channel while partner fixes client. PR #342 to update eval window can wait til after partner confirms.

ben: I'll ack the PD alert and add note to incident timeline.

alice: contacting partner, message sent.

carol: thanks — will monitor dashboards for next 30m. If 502s increase we escalate. :eyes:
